description: Sign this MCP server (and the qualiloop CLI) in to QualiLoop. Opens the approval page in the user's browser and returns the link and a code. Tell the user to approve it there and check the code (a new user creates an account from that page first); then call qualiloop_status, which waits for the approval, until it shows them signed in. Do not ask the user to say when they are done.
name: sign_in
